convert_vilt_checkpoint: convert a ViLT checkpoint from the original GitHub repository to a HuggingFace PyTorch model
create_rename_keys: create key rename mappings between original ViLT and HuggingFace model architectures
read_in_q_k_v: split combined query-key-value projection weights into separate attention layers
remove_classification_head_: remove classification head weights from a model state dictionary
run_convert_cli: run the ViLT checkpoint conversion CLI with a checkpoint URL and output directory path
